subject: TAKING metal probe batch-features-v9: nord2_metal_probe.m, analyze_metal_probe.py (+test), build_metal_probe.sh (+1 .ll), new tests/shaders/metal_probe_fetch.ll
body: Root cause of the missing batch_complete/final_status: the kernel LOG selector has a 16384-byte quota per user client (Nord2GPU.cpp:663) and the v8 probe logs ~16.3 KB (c6gc/c6jb USB logs stop at 16279/16281 B, right before 'batch complete'; only the stdout-reconciled c1 log has it). v9 keeps per-pass memory/status lines on stdout only, budgets the kernel log with a reserve for summary/final lines, and emits a summary line after every feature group. New tagged exact-pixel tests: feature=tilefetch-batch, preframe-partial, batch-cap, indexed-attr, indexed-strip-restart, async-many, cmdpool-reuse (fault induction reported as SKIP: unsafe for the context). Plus bridge batch trace line with heap-used (my batching code).
